name: WF-185 — Active Closing Execution → Critical-Date & Milestone Monitoring Loop

parameters.jsCode: const x=$json??{}; const e=x.execution_activation??x.execution??{}; const s=e.active_state??x.active_state??{}; const ms=Array.isArray(s.milestones)?s.milestones:[]; const nowMs=Date.parse(x.now??new Date().toISOString()); const closingAt=Date.parse(x.closing_date??x.closingDate??s.closing_date??''); const blockers=Array.isArray(x.blockers)?x.blockers.filter(Boolean):[]; const evaluated=ms.map((m,i)=>{const due=Date.parse(m.due_at??m.dueAt??m.due_date??''); const done=m.status==='completed'||m.completed===true; const overdue=!done&&Number.isFinite(due)&&due<nowMs; const critical=m.critical===true||m.priority==='critical'; return {...m,sequence:m.sequence??i+1,status:done?'completed':overdue?'overdue':(m.status??'pending'),overdue,critical};}); const overdue=evaluated.filter(m=>m.overdue); const criticalOverdue=overdue.filter(m=>m.critical); const daysToClose=Number.isFinite(closingAt)?Math.ceil((closingAt-nowMs)/86400000):null; let status=blockers.length?'blocked':criticalOverdue.length?'critical_overdue':overdue.length?'attention_required':daysToClose!==null&&daysToClose<=1?'closing_due_soon':evaluated.length&&evaluated.every(m=>m.status==='completed')?'milestones_completed':'on_track'; const route=status==='blocked'?'WF-126':status==='critical_overdue'?'WF-155':status==='attention_required'||status==='closing_due_soon'?'WF-155':status==='milestones_completed'?'WF-137':'WF-136'; return [{json:{...x,workflow:'WF-185',monitoring:{status,checked_at:x.now??new Date().toISOString(),closing_date:x.closing_date??x.closingDate??s.closing_date??null,days_to_closing:daysToClose,overdue_count:overdue.length,critical_overdue_count:criticalOverdue.length,milestones:evaluated,blockers},routing:{next_workflow:route,requires_human_review:status==='blocked'||status==='critical_overdue'},audit:{event:'active_closing_milestone_monitoring_evaluated',status}}}];
